description: [Bookstack](https://codeberg.org/bookstack/bookstack) is a free and open source Wiki designed for creating beautiful documentation. Featuring a simple, but powerful WYSIWYG editor it allows for teams to create detailed and useful documentation with ease. Powered by SQL and including a Markdown editor for those who prefer it, BookStack is geared towards making documentation more of a pleasure than a chore. For more information on BookStack visit their website and check it out: https://www.bookstackapp.com
